name: 4280-batchdecode-qwen05b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 7680 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain`, every request exactly 256 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens (min = max = mean on both), temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos so every answer is exactly 256 tokens. `plain` is declared rather than left to default: the checkpoint ships a chat_template, and under the backend's default `default-template` the same prompt re-encodes to 275 tokens instead of 256.
purpose: A compact half-billion-parameter chat assistant generating fixed 256-token replies to 256 concurrent short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# April-2024 AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- there is no V1 engine, no compilation-config,
# no calculate-kv-scales, no --async-scheduling at this commit.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
